_doc: Per-bot placement and character for the screened roster.
GENERATED, not authored. Home and faction come from RULES over the class
and the filename's `_aka_` inspiration half, applied against the film
material's own geography: the coalition shield around Earth, Blackstar's
clans taxing Titan and Io, the Corrupted where something is wrong
underneath, the Hijacks outside the boundary.
81 of 259 filenames carry an inspiration (`tank--judgementor-aka large
walker tank`), and those write their own hook. The rest fall back to what
their class means mechanically, which is honest but thin — those are the
ones worth writing by hand.
HOW THIN THIS ACTUALLY IS, measured rather than claimed: 89 distinct hooks
across 259 bots. Fifty-six grimorphs share one line, forty flyers share
another. The 81 with an `_aka_` inspiration read individually because the
filename did the work; the other 178 read as their class, which is
placement metadata wearing a costume, not character.
The fix is not more adjectives. It is hooks derived from what each model
MEASURES — its lift class, its drive type, its solidity and reach, whether
it carries a rotor or a turret — because those already differ per model and
the tooling to read them exists. That is a pass over the geometry rather
than over the names, and it is the next step here.
